reason: Presumed to continue: the Native Bee Society of BC Bee Atlas Collection on GBIF holds 2021–2025 under CC BY-NC 4.0 (checked 2026-10-10). Nothing earlier is published, so seasons before 2021 have no licence.

Presumed to continue: OSAC's Oregon Bee Atlas dataset on GBIF (release 2026-07-28) holds 2017–2024 under CC BY-NC 4.0, republishing the 2017–2018 records its 2018 dataset had put out under CC BY 4.0, so CC BY-NC is the licence most recently used for every season.

Presumed to continue: Washington's records reach GBIF through Ecdysis inside WSU's collection dataset (Washington State University Collection, d4359efd-992b-414d-9b0a-3b83cb71b5c8), under CC BY-NC 4.0; confirmed on WSDA_2303966, collected 2023-04-29. Earlier seasons are not yet checked. 17 USC 105 makes only federal works public domain, so it does not reach WSDA's.
